start.card:
Welcome to the game show! There are 3 doors. Behind one is a car. Behind each of the other two is a goat.
You pick a door. The host knows where the car is. He opens a different door that has a goat. Then he asks: do you stay with your door, or switch to the other closed door?
First, make a guess below.
start.title: Stay or Switch?

afterGuess.card:
You guessed: "Staying wins more often".
Now play one round. Click a door to pick it.
afterGuess.title: Stay or Switch?

after.card:
You picked door 1. The host opened door 3, and it's a goat!
Two doors are still closed: yours (door 1) and door 2. Stay or switch? Use the buttons below.
after.title: Stay or Switch?
